integrity: The unrestricted formulas follow from explicit polynomial factorization, finite-field character sums, and Hensel lifting; finite checks independently confirm 34 prime-power cases but are not a proof. No independent validation has been performed.
limitations: Good primes p>=7 only; no claimed classification at p=2,3,5. The prime-field Dickson value-set count is prior work; Galois-ring historical priority remains qualified because a closely related 1991 paper could not be inspected in full.
title: Exact good-prime-power images and p-adic density of pentatope numbers
